items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And she taught me how to count my blessings... she would teach me how to explain these good deeds

ctx.x: But she was a good woman. She was a good human being. And she taught me how to count my blessings. I'll say it thataway, as for respectful. So she said I should write down these good deeds that I do, and being head of the class, she said, let's put it down. And my daughter, when she gets home, she will tell you how to put it on paper where you can get up and explain it.

And she would say, 'you can read your own writing, can't you?' And I said, 'yes, ma'am,' you know, said -- so that's really what happened. When my Aunt E(unintelligible)came home, she would teach me how to explain these good deeds, you see? So like healping an old person on to the streetcar --
